_name: Polymarket BTC 5M — Piste 3: bid scaling + capital cap + weekly stop + OBI=-0.65
_description: Piste 2 + obi_reject_thresh=-0.65 (calibrated via scripts/calibrate_obi.py sweep). Filters the four negative-PnL OBI buckets (OBI < -0.65, WR 92-95%) while retaining the 2357/3397 trades where OBI >= -0.65 (WR 97-100%). Calibration result on paper3+liveweek: PnL +$268 (+35% vs piste1/2), MaxDD $72 (-31%), skip=30.6%. The -0.25 threshold tested in an earlier iteration was too aggressive (88% skip, PnL -70%).
